name: tracker-supervisor-worker-isolation
goal: A blocked adapter poll cannot delay other worker ticks, an individual worker cannot overlap itself, and cancellation drains all active ticks before SQLite closes.

evidence: A slow adapter stalls subsequent notification/dispatch/recurrence passes because all workers are awaited by the same poll loop. Each worker must repeat independently and drain before close.
The existing supervisor run/status/shutdown case blocked the only worker and never required another worker to keep ticking. Strengthen it with a held adapter and repeated notifications.
At a7c95dc170 the committed test observed one notification tick while the adapter was blocked; expected more than one.
Run one non-overlapping poll loop per configured worker under the common lifetime and drain all workers before close.
